This is useful if you want to temporarily disable a server without removing it from your config.\n[...]\nAdd local MCP servers using&#96;type&#96; to&#96;\"local\"&#96; within the MCP object.\n[...]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n{\n  \"$schema\": \"https://opencode.ai/config.json\",\n  \"mcp\": {\n    \"my-local-mcp-server\": {\n      \"type\": \"local\",\n      // Or [\"bun\", \"x\", \"my-mcp-command\"]\n      \"command\": [\"npx\", \"-y\", \"my-mcp-command\"],\n      \"enabled\": true,\n      \"environment\": {\n        \"MY_ENV_VAR\": \"my_env_var_value\",\n      },\n    },\n  },\n}\n[...]\n--- | --- |\n[...]\nAdd remote MCP servers by setting&#96;type&#96; to&#96;\"remote\"&#96;.\n[...]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n{\n  \"$schema\": \"https://opencode.ai/config.json\",\n  \"mcp\": {\n    \"my-remote-mcp\": {\n      \"type\": \"remote\",\n      \"url\": \"https://my-mcp-server.com\",\n      \"enabled\": true,\n      \"headers\": {\n        \"Authorization\": \"Bearer MY_API_KEY\"\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n[...]\nThe&#96;url&#96; is the URL of the remote MCP server and with the&#96;headers&#96; option you can pass in a list of headers.\n[...]\n| Option | Type | Required | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| &#96;type&#96; | String | Y | Type of MCP server connection, must be&#96;\"remote\"&#96;. |\n| &#96;url&#96; | String | Y | URL of the remote MCP server. |\n| &#96;enabled&#96; | Boolean | Enable or disable the MCP server on startup. |\n| &#96;headers&#96; | Object | Headers to send with the request. |\n| &#96;oauth&#96; | Object | OAuth authentication configuration. _**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

Fixed. OpenCode was rejecting the config because it used the Cursor/Claude MCP shape (`command` + `args`) instead of OpenCode’s schema.

**Problem:** `opencode mcp list` failed with:
```
Configuration is invalid at /Users/liamellis/.config/opencode/config.json
↳ Invalid input mcp.gitnexus
```

**Cause:** OpenCode requires:
- `type: "local"` (or `"remote"`)
- `command` as a single string array (not separate `command` + `args`)
- No extra fields (`args` is invalid)

**Fix applied:**

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "mcp": {
    "gitnexus": {
      "type": "local",
      "command": ["npx", "-y", "gitnexus@latest", "mcp"],
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

**Verification:** `opencode mcp list` now parses the config and lists the server. GitNexus itself timed out on first connect (~30s), which is a runtime/network issue, not a config problem. If that persists, try running `npx -y gitnexus@latest mcp` directly or bump `timeout` in the config.
